data.narrative:
Skyryse is a Series C-stage Space & Aerospace company with a last post-money valuation of $1.15B and $500M+ raised to date. The valuation assessment triangulates against a comp universe of 6 private peers at similar or adjacent stages (Sierra Space, Impulse Space, Apex Space, Cowboy Space Corporation, and Varda Space Industries) and 5 public Space & Aerospace traded companies (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL).

Two methods are applicable. Stage-Progression analysis applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C to next-stage advancement against the $1.1B base, yielding $2.0B. Peer-Median triangulation across the six same-sector, same/adjacent-stage privates produces a $2.1B implied value, with a peer range spanning $1.3B to $8.0B. Public-Comp anchoring cannot be applied due to the absence of disclosed revenue figures. Public sector P/S multiples median 24.6x across the five traded comps, but this requires target revenue data not on file.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $1.7B (low) to $2.5B (high), with a median of $2.1B. This implies modest upside from the current $1.15B round valuation. Key uncertainties include revenue trajectory and the wide dispersion within the peer set ($1.3B–$8.0B), particularly the outsized Sierra Space valuation at $8.0B, which may reflect company-specific competitive positioning or market timing effects not fully captured in this cross-sectional analysis.
